name: liamtra/tts-phpmailer-deps
description: PHPMailer for the Travellers-Flight-Api-Platform admin panel (adminpanel/). Installs straight into vendor/phpmailer so require 'vendor/phpmailer/autoload.php' keeps working unchanged.
